title: A single-lattice covering bound of order n log n
summary: Every convex body in ℝ n , n ≥ 2, admits a covering by translates along one full-rank lattice with density at most $`Cn\log n`$, for an absolute constant C . No symmetry or boundary regularity is assumed.
family_title: The optimal order of convex-body covering density

review.reason: Proves an n log n density bound for covering convex bodies by one lattice's translates.
